name: Milk Pasteurization Temperature & Time Chart
secondary_keywords: htst milk pasteurisation time and temperature
dairy food safety pasteurization legal limits uk
search_intent: Dairy farmers, artisanal cheesemakers, commercial baristas, and food technology students needing statutory time-temperature pasteurisation combinations for bovine and caprine milk (HTST continuous, LTLT batch, UHT sterilization), thermal lethality curves for Coxiella burnetii, and alkaline phosphatase validation.

competitors.title: Grade A Pasteurized Milk Ordinance (PMO) | FDA
competitors.weaknesses: 400-page complex regulatory PDF, impossible to parse on mobile.

competitors.title: Milk and Dairy Hygiene Guidance | Food Standards Agency
competitors.weaknesses: Legal text summary, lacks clear visual comparison of HTST vs LTLT vs UHT and ALP testing.

competitors.title: Pasteurization of Milk | Dairy Processing Handbook
competitors.weaknesses: Industrial engineering textbook format, lacks quick reference tools for catering or smallholders.

competitors.title: International Dairy Federation Pasteurization Standards | IDF
Milk Pasteurization Overview | ScienceDirect
competitors.weaknesses: Academic journal paywall, lacks usable commercial chart format.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: 400-page regulatory PDFs or paywalled academic literature.
gap_analysis.what_they_lack: An ungated, interactive browser chart comparing all 4 dairy processing profiles (LTLT, HTST, HHST, UHT), alkaline phosphatase (ALP) verification criteria, and printable wall chart.
gap_analysis.what_we_offer: Interactive dairy pasteurisation tool with time-temperature matrices, target zoonotic pathogen destruction profiles, ALP testing benchmarks, and one-click printable chart.
